Before opening this, please skim [CONTRIBUTING.md's "Scope" section](../CONTRIBUTING.md#scope) —
git-envdiff stays intentionally small (Go stdlib only, no network outside
`update`, no values ever read from `.env`), and a request that falls
outside that will likely be declined regardless of how good the idea is on
its own. If it's a schema/validation/secrets/cloud idea, it may fit better
as a note on [docs/COMPARISON.md](../docs/COMPARISON.md) than as a feature
here.

**What problem are you running into?**
(Describe the situation, not just the feature — the same problem sometimes
has a smaller fix than the one you have in mind.)

**What would you like to happen?**

**How does this fit within git-envdiff's scope**, as described above?
